pages.title: Marsh Deer
pages.text: The marsh deer ($(o)Blastocerus dichotomus$()) is the largest deer in South America, living in the wetlands and floodplains of the continent's centre, from Brazil to northern Argentina.$(br2)Its hooves are long and can spread widely, supported by membranes between the toes that help it walk on soft, waterlogged ground.$(br2)Marsh deer are strong swimmers and feed mainly on aquatic and marshland plants.
